page.text:
A *group* is a monoid in which every element has an inverse: for each $x$
there is a $y$ with $x * y = e$ and $y * x = e$. Groups are the central
structure of elementary algebra, being exactly the structures whose
operation can always be undone. They are the abstract theory of symmetry.
